description:
£145 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to welcome back to the student lettings market this spacious five bedroom student house, ideally situated on Buston Terrace in the heart of Jesmond.

Spread over three floors, this fantastic property offers generous accommodation throughout, making it an ideal choice for a group of students looking for a traditional house with plenty of space.

The property features a central living room connecting to a galley style kitchen, as well as a rare conservatory, providing additional communal space for relaxing and socialising with housemates.

Located in central Jesmond, the property is ideally positioned close to Manor House Road, offering easy access to the area's popular attractions, including the bars and restaurants on Osborne Road, local shops and nearby Metro stations. Both Newcastle and Northumbria Universities are also within convenient reach, with the university campus less than a 20-minute walk away.

If you're looking for a spacious student house in a prime Jesmond location, this property is not to be missed!

Contact My Property Box today and speak to our Lettings Team to arrange your viewing.
